## Description

**What**: Update project documentation to reflect the DESIGN.md linter governance system introduced by this epic.
**Why**: New config keys, audit commands, and migration paths must be documented for consumers.
**Scope**:
- IN: CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md updates for design.lint_enabled, HOOKS-REFERENCE.md for the pre-commit lint hook, any CLAUDE.md rule candidates (via CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report only)
- OUT: DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md (covered by draft-7)

## Done Definitions

- Documentation accurately reflects the new design.lint_enabled config gate, design-md-lint.sh pre-commit hook, and migration path
- DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block is included in the completion report
- Any CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE reports are surfaced to the user before story closes
- No stale documentation references to the old design-notes.md path remain in project docs

## Considerations

- Apply plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/doc-router.md gates before writing. CLAUDE.md edits require a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — do not edit CLAUDE.md directly.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect DESIGN.md linter governance
